//: Firestore rules only. Hosting is Cloudflare Pages — see public/_headers.
Firebase Hosting was the first choice and the wrong one: its free tier
allows 360 MB of transfer a day, and this app is 206 KB gzipped per first
load, so roughly 1,700 visits exhausts a day. It is a cliff, not a
throttle: past it the site stops serving until midnight. Cloudflare Pages
has no bandwidth limit on its free tier and a stronger edge presence in
Southeast Asia, Africa and South America, which is where these readers are.

firestore.//: Named database — rules are per-database, and the default one is not
firestore.//2: the one this project uses. See firestore.rules: it denies everything,
firestore.//3: because the app never touches Firestore.
